test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the position in the English alphabetical order, three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.

Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

1) SUZY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4445b3e17158f21ce3886305ba98e5e9ac015ae95afdf932e4241a2ff2f93cd0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/419c988579fb2810584a8f9262acec3e4977ef14c6c7b6e4963875d311bd678c.png] 

**2) MPUT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1423cb6d15d270d3a01a601d00179905a647dbab2cfd5ee8210544d3802b43d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/706efce7a678f31d00538ac613c86da0015a94e611bbe3a2fa6796832971e7bb.png] 

3) QSXW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2202d303386239af988b451f9537b2381ea1ca5bd21d2f969a736a403bafde5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a07f8831953ba20d3d9e68c3c1a815a4f57cb81c8a3eb50defe1aee3dac4b207.png] 

4) PRWV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c642c6936efebead32af8fed7827db626fd9dcdd7e3bbdc5c834f8e6042231e2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de86bd841b98d119aaf02a27d084a1ac2ad891d03a980a07bc65931bebe23a9a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MPUT".**
